title: Automatic Securities Disposition Plan Established by Canada Goose Chief Executive Officer
summary: Canada Goose Holdings Inc. ("Canada Goose" or the "Company") (NYSE: GOOS) (TSX: GOOS) today announced that its Chief Executive Officer and Chair of the board of directors, Dani Reiss, established an automatic securities disposition plan (ASDP) in accordance with applicable United States and Canadian securities legislation and the Company's internal policies. The ASDP permits trades to be made in accordance with pre-arranged instructions given when Mr. Reiss was not in possession of any material undisclosed information. The ASDP will be effective on the later of (i) 90 days following the date hereof, and (ii) the second trading day following the date on which the Company has filed its interim financial statements for the quarter ending June 28, 2026. Sales of the subordinate voting shares under the ASDP may only commence as of such effective date.
